name: Beta-Carboline
summary: Beta-Carboline is a documented other compound on PsychonautWiki.

pharmacology.text: The compound has been found to possess a variety of pharmacological activities, including DNA mutagenic effects, imidazoline receptor interactions, serotonin reuptake inhibition, monoamine oxidase inhibition, cytochrome P450 enzyme inhibition, and inhibition of other enzymes, among others. β-Carboline is a weak reversible inhibitor of monoamine oxidase A (RIMA), with an IC50 of 1,700 nM.

summaryZh: β-咔啉是一種含氮雜環有機化合物，分子式C11H8N2，是許多生物鹼的結構母體。
summaryZhHans: β-咔啉是一种含氮杂环有机化合物，分子式C11H8N2，是许多生物碱的结构母体。

uses.en: Some are used in ayahuasca brews to let DMT work when drunk. Others are research tools, and some are studied for their effects on monoamine oxidase and on benzodiazepine binding sites.
uses.zh: 其中一些用於死藤水煎劑，使 DMT 在飲用時仍能作用。其他則是研究工具，有些因對單胺氧化酶與苯二氮平結合位的作用而被研究。
uses.zhHans: 其中一些用于死藤水煎剂，使 DMT 在饮用时仍能作用。其他则是研究工具，有些因对单胺氧化酶与苯二氮平结合位的作用而被研究。

sideEffects.en: Effects vary across the family. The monoamine oxidase inhibiting ones cause nausea, vomiting and tremor, and can cause a dangerous rise in blood pressure with tyramine-rich foods. Some beta-carbolines cause anxiety or convulsions in animals.
sideEffects.zh: 這個家族的作用差異很大。具單胺氧化酶抑制作用者會造成噁心、嘔吐與顫抖，並可能在與富含酪胺的食物並用時造成血壓危險升高。某些 β-咔啉在動物身上會引起焦慮或抽搐。
sideEffects.zhHans: 这个家族的作用差异很大。具单胺氧化酶抑制作用者会造成恶心、呕吐与颤抖，并可能在与富含酪胺的食物并用时造成血压危险升高。某些 β-咔啉在动物身上会引起焦虑或抽搐。

fact.en: Beta-carbolines are everywhere: they form when food is cooked, especially grilled meat and coffee beans, and they occur in tobacco smoke as well as in the ayahuasca vine.
fact.zh: β-咔啉無處不在：食物烹調時會生成它們，尤其是燒烤肉類與咖啡豆，菸草煙霧與死藤水的藤蔓中也含有它們。
fact.zhHans: β-咔啉无处不在：食物烹调时会生成它们，尤其是烧烤肉类与咖啡豆，烟草烟雾与死藤水的藤蔓中也含有它们。
